title: Mixed Event — Resonating with you — Episode5 My Response

meta.Event Outline: Ichika and the others learn that Shiho has been scouted by another band. Shiho is finally able to express what she's been feeling, but how will her bandmates respond?

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Shiho can't make it today either.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She said she's busy with work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Quit apologizing and let's practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I do want to get better, but together... With all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What was going through her mind while she was working with each us of...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But she did say that she wants to get better, together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She did...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought we'd be able to hang out more too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wonder what it's like to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wouldn't know. It always felt like those people lived in a completely different world than us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The first time Shiho told me that she wanted to go pro, I thought that it would be sort of nice if I could as well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I always knew that it wasn't really possible. I don't think I ever actually wanted to...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This mindset is what's causing her so much pain.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're not alone, Ichika.
I fell into the same trap...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I want to be in a band with her. I don't want her to leave us for some other band...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That I know is true...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I guess that's not enough for her...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right...
If we aren't ready to actually start working towards becoming pros ourselves, we'll just end up hurting Shiho more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So if we're getting in the way of Shiho's dream coming true...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Should we break up our band...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Becoming a pro, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are they going to be okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're definitely between a rock and hard place. I'm not even sure what to tell them right now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And Shiho may be going through the same thing right now as well...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
They care about each other so much...
But that's also what makes this so hard...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, Miku...
Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Do you know what it means...?
What's needed to become a pro...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I haven't stopped thinking about it ever since Shiho told us about that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Becoming a pro...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure I can say since I'm not a professional myself...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But maybe it has something to do with constantly trying to understand what your music is about...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Understanding our music?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is that it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, there has to be more to it than that! What about having to push the other things you want to do to the side and stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That I can't say...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not even Miku can answer this one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. I've never thought about turning pro or how to do it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can at least say that I don't think resolve and commitment aren't things you can learn about from others.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So we have to find that answer ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku.
Music Shop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Understanding our music, huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I sort of get it but not really...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do we not know how to do that yet...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe. As much as we've been practicing, I'm not sure we've reached that level of understanding yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hey...! A STANDOUT CD.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right. They're being featured as a one of the hottest indie bands out there right now. I guess they are just that famous.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Music that moves people...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho probably wants to perform just the way they did...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But there's no way we can match them right now. Maybe we should let Shiho be free and pursue her dream with STANDOUT...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If Shiho joins them, she could actually make it and debut as a pro...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But what if she starts drifting away from us...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm sure we can still see each other. We can still be friends, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I can't let that happen...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I want us to stay together...
I want us four to be in a band...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You're right!
We have to tell her that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree. I wouldn't have it any other way.
But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho's probably thinking long and hard about which path she wants to take too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can't go into this half-hearted. She needs to clearly know how we feel and what we plan to do about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We need to think about what it really means to go pro, and if we're willing to make that commitment...
